lavra.name: Kyiv Pechersk Lavra
lavra.price_text: ≈ UAH 100–200 entry per zone; cave tickets extra. Check on the day.
lavra.hours: Grounds roughly 09:00–18:00 daily; caves and some churches close earlier
lavra.tip: Cover shoulders and knees. The Far Caves are a separate ticket and a long walk downhill.
lavra.best: Morning on a weekday; avoid midday crowds

sophia.name: St. Sophia's Cathedral
sophia.price_text: ≈ UAH 80–180 depending on zones; bell tower extra
sophia.hours: Roughly 10:00–18:00, closed Thursday; check on the day
sophia.tip: The 11th-century mosaics and frescoes are the highlight. Buy the combined ticket if you want the bell tower view.
sophia.best: Late morning; grounds are lovely in spring

maidan.name: Maidan Nezalezhnosti
maidan.tip: Start here to get your bearings. The glass dome and Independence Monument are the meeting points.

andrew.name: St. Andrew's Church
andrew.price_text: ≈ UAH 50–100 entry; check on the day
andrew.tip: Climb the steps from Andriyivskyy Descent for the best photo of the blue-and-gold facade.

goldengate.name: Golden Gate, Zoloti Vorota
goldengate.tip: Small museum inside the reconstructed gate. The little park around it is a good rest stop.

motherland.name: Motherland Monument, Kyiv
motherland.price_text: ≈ UAH 150–300 for the museum and viewing platforms; check on the day
motherland.tip: The terrace under the statue gives a wide Dnieper view. Book ahead if you want the top platform.

andriyivskyy.name: Andriyivskyy Descent
andriyivskyy.price_text: Free to walk; souvenirs cost extra
andriyivskyy.hours: Always open; stalls busiest late morning to evening
andriyivskyy.tip: Cobblestones are uneven, wear flat shoes. Walk down from St. Andrew's Church toward Podil.

ancientkyiv.name: Ancient Kyiv, Principality of Kyivan Rus
ancientkyiv.landmark: Ancient Kyiv, Principality of Kyivan Rus
ancientkyiv.price_text: ≈ UAH 150–350 entry; check on the day
ancientkyiv.tip: Open-air recreation of Kyivan Rus outside the centre. Allow half a day with transport.

dnieper.name: Dnieper River embankment
dnieper.tip: Walk the embankment near the Lavra for river views. Boat trips run in summer, check on the day.

khreshchatyk.name: Khreshchatyk Street
khreshchatyk.tip: Main street, closed to cars at weekends. Good for a stroll between Maidan and the Golden Gate.

olimpiyskiy.name: NSC Olimpiyskiy
olimpiyskiy.price_text: Ticket price depends on the event; check on the day
olimpiyskiy.hours: Only open for events and tours
olimpiyskiy.tip: Check the fixture list before you go. Stadium tours run on some days only.

shevchenkomuseum.name: Shevchenko National Museum
shevchenkomuseum.tip: Good introduction to Ukraine's national poet. Labels are mostly in Ukrainian.

cyril.name: St. Cyril's Monastery
cyril.tip: Quiet church with rare 12th-century frescoes. It is away from the centre, so plan transport.

volodymyr.name: St. Volodymyr's Cathedral
volodymyr.hours: Roughly 08:00–19:00 daily; services may limit visits
volodymyr.tip: Dress modestly. The interior paintings are the reason to come.

besarabka.name: Besarabsky Market
besarabka.price_text: Free to enter; food priced per item
besarabka.tip: Go for cheese, honey and smoked fish. Bring cash for small stalls.

volodymyrhill.name: Volodymyr Hill viewpoint
volodymyrhill.tip: Best Dnieper and Podil panorama in the centre. Walk down to the river if you have time.

podilwalk.name: Podil neighbourhood walk
podilwalk.price_text: Free to walk; cafés cost extra
podilwalk.tip: Wander between Kontraktova Square and the river port. Good cafés and old streets.

chernobyltour.name: Chernobyl exclusion zone day tour
chernobyltour.price_text: ≈ UAH 3,000–5,000 per person; check current rules before booking
chernobyltour.tip: Rules and access change often. Book only with a licensed operator and confirm it is running.

riverboat.name: Dnieper river boat trip
riverboat.tip: Boats leave from the river station area. Sit on the open deck for the best views.

lvivchocolate.name: Lviv Chocolate Workshop, Kyiv
lvivchocolate.tip: Warm chocolate drink is the classic order. Small café, so it fills up fast.

peremoha.name: Peremoha Park
peremoha.tip: Green riverside park near the Lavra. Good for a quiet walk after the monastery.
